prior.evidence: The Content lookup fails row specifies a 503 with Cache-Control: no-store when a required DB lookup fails, prohibits substituting an older query result, and gives successful cache freshness (600 seconds plus 86400-second stale-while-revalidate) with publication invalidation.

The Contact delivery fails after saving row directs the operator to Payload's form-submissions list and saved record, then defines manual reply through the configured mailbox and recording that it was handled; automatic resend and custom retry UI are explicitly unnecessary for v1.
